description.value:
Over the course of the casting time, you establish a lasting link between a tracker droid and your tech focus. The droid acts independently but always follows your commands, acting on your turn in combat.

While the droid is within 100 feet of you, you can communicate with it through your tech focus. As an action, you can also see and hear through the droid's senses until the start of your next turn, gaining any special senses it has; while doing so, you are deaf and blind to your own surroundings.

You can maintain a link with only one tracker droid at a time. When you cast a power with a range of touch, your linked droid can deliver it in your place, provided it is within 100 feet of you and uses its reaction to do so; if the power requires an attack roll, you use your own attack modifier.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, you can maintain one additional link for every two slot levels beyond 1st. Linked droids share an initiative count, though you can perceive through only one at a time, switching between them as a bonus action; each must remain within 100 feet of you.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
